name: MicroAcquire (now Acquire.com)

sources.title: MicroAcquire holding page — rebranded to Acquire.com ('world's largest marketplace for buying and selling profitable online businesses'; $500M+ closed deals, 2,000+ startups sold, 500k+ entrepreneurs); 'List your startup for free' on Acquire.com; all functional links point to acquire.com

conditions: The destination still works but is a redirect/landing page for acquire.com — the actual listing flow happens on Acquire.com. Also, this is a marketplace for SELLING a startup, not launching one
requirements: An actual business to sell — Acquire.com is a startup-acquisition marketplace (SaaS, ecommerce, agencies); listing is about exiting, not launching
The listing flow lives on acquire.com — 'list your startup for free', sellers list with metrics/MRR; buyers are verified ($2B+ verified buyer funds claimed)
microacquire.com itself is just a rebrand explainer — every CTA goes to acquire.com
preparation: Only relevant if the goal is selling the business — revenue metrics, P&L, growth data for buyer diligence
workflow: List the startup on the seller flow with revenue/growth metrics
Vetted buyers make offers; Acquire.com facilitates escrow/closing
watchFor: Wrong purpose for a launch — this is an M&A marketplace, not a launch destination; keep the catalog entry for completeness but flag it
The cataloged domain is now a static rebrand page — actual product is acquire.com
'Free' listing is marketplace-standard; success fees likely apply at closing (not verified this session)
countsAsLive: A sale listing exists on acquire.com (microacquire.com itself produces no listing)
